messages:
Sophie: Heads-up — opened PR to fix the 'cold-start' section in the quantized models README. Link broken and example showed `generate()` where it should show embeddings. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/8123
Mike: Link saved. I can run the snippet smoke tests once it's updated.
Adesh: CI showed a failure in the snippet runner, reproducing locally now (failing import on line 1).
Sophie: Yep. The example should call `client.embeddings.create(...)` and reference the quantized variant name. Draft snippet I'm proposing:
```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
c = RedwoodClient()
resp = c.embeddings.create(model="zephyrx-quant-ggml", input="hello world")
print(resp.data[0].embedding)
```
Nora: Also please add a short note about cold-start memory footprint and a link to the quantization profile page: https://docs.redwood.com/quantization#cold-start
Mike: I'll update the example, run the linter and the snippet smoke test. :+1:
devex-bot: Preview build created — https://deploy.preview.redwood.com/preview/8123 — snippet check failed: outdated SDK syntax (v1 vs v2) at snippet line 2.
Sophie: Good catch. Switching to SDK v2 style. New snippet:
```python
import os
from redwood import Client
client = Client(api_key=os.environ.get("REDWOOD_KEY"))
emb = client.embeddings.create(model='zephyrx-quant-v2', input='hello')
print(emb[0])
```
Adesh: LGTM. Can we also add a one-line limit note: quantized variants have a sequence-length ceiling (<= 2048) in the README limits table? I'll add it.
Nora: Also worth a tiny bench note — quantized cold-start p95 can be ~2-3x slower on first request vs warmed containers. A one-sentence callout should be enough.
Mike: I'll add the bench line and re-run the preview. If green I'll merge. :rocket:
devex-bot: Preview smoke tests passed — snippet runner OK. :white_check_mark:
Sophie: Thanks everyone — merging after final CI completes.
